q: How many customers are there?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

q: How many orders were placed in 1997?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 1997

q: Which 3 customers placed the most orders, and how many did each place?
gold: SELECT c.company_name, COUNT(*) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.company_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

q: List the 5 most expensive products and their prices.
gold: SELECT product_name, unit_price FROM products ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 5

q: How many products are in each category?
gold: SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name

q: How many orders did each shipping company handle?
gold: SELECT s.company_name, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN shippers s ON o.ship_via = s.shipper_id GROUP BY s.company_name

q: What is the last name of the employee who handled the most orders, and how many orders was that?
gold: SELECT e.last_name, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id GROUP BY e.last_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q: What was the total revenue after discounts in 1997?
gold: SELECT SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) FROM order_details od JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = od.order_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 1997

q: What was the revenue after discounts for each product category in 1997?
gold: SELECT c.category_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) FROM order_details od JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = od.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = od.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 1997 GROUP BY c.category_name

q: Which country has the most customers, and how many?
gold: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many products are discontinued?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE discontinued = 1

q: Which products are out of stock?
gold: SELECT product_name FROM products WHERE units_in_stock = 0

q: What is the average freight cost per order for each shipping company?
gold: SELECT s.company_name, AVG(o.freight) FROM orders o JOIN shippers s ON o.ship_via = s.shipper_id GROUP BY s.company_name

q: How many orders were placed in each month of 1997?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 1997 GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date)

q: Which suppliers are based in Germany?
gold: SELECT company_name FROM suppliers WHERE country = 'Germany'

q: What are the top 5 products by total quantity sold?
gold: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(od.quantity) FROM order_details od JOIN products p ON p.product_id = od.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

q: Which customers have never placed an order?
gold: SELECT company_name FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL)

q: How many orders were shipped after their required date?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE shipped_date > required_date

q: What is the average number of days between order date and shipped date for shipped orders?
gold: SELECT AVG(shipped_date - order_date) FROM orders WHERE shipped_date IS NOT NULL

q: List the last names of employees who report to Andrew Fuller.
gold: SELECT e.last_name FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON e.reports_to = m.employee_id WHERE m.first_name = 'Andrew' AND m.last_name = 'Fuller'

q: Which countries have more than 5 customers, and how many customers does each have?
gold: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(*) > 5

q: What is the total value of stock on hand (unit price times units in stock) across all products?
gold: SELECT SUM(unit_price * units_in_stock) FROM products

q: Which product category generated the highest revenue after discounts across all years?
gold: SELECT c.category_name FROM order_details od JOIN products p ON p.product_id = od.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many distinct products has the customer Ernst Handel ordered?
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT od.product_id) FROM order_details od JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = od.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.company_name = 'Ernst Handel'

q: How many orders contain more than 5 different products?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_details GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) t
